candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Pritožbe uporabnikov finančnih storitev (complaints against supervised entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Central bank page describing the formal complaint channel against banks, savings banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, payment system operators and credit intermediaries. Defines the legal complaint taxonomy (ZPlaSSIED, ZPotK-2, ZVPot-1, ZPPDFT-2, ZCKR, ZSJV) that structures all downstream complaint statistics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML fetch of the page plus linked PDFs; monitor for annual complaint statistics releases
queries_used: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije pritožbe banke plačilne storitve

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Letna poročila (annual reports incl. consumer-protection/complaint chapters)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual reports carry aggregate counts and themes of consumer complaints and supervisory actions against banks/PSPs — the closest thing to an official complaint-volume time series in Slovenia.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF harvest + text extraction of complaint/consumer chapters
queries_used: Banka Slovenije letno poročilo o pritožbah uporabnikov finančnih storitev 2025

candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – Izvajalec izvensodnega reševanja potrošniških sporov (IRPS/ADR for banks)
candidates.why_relevant: ZBS is the recognised out-of-court consumer ADR body for Slovenian banks. Its ADR pages and annual reports disclose case volumes, dispute subject matter (unauthorised payment transactions, card fraud, fees, credit) and outcomes — a direct read on where banks fail their customers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape ADR section; harvest ZBS annual report PDFs yearly and extract the IRPS chapter
queries_used: izvensodno reševanje sporov banka Slovenija izvajalec IRPS potrošnik pritožba

candidates.source_name: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije (ZPS) – consumer advice, market reviews and bank-fee comparisons
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's main consumer association. Publishes named-bank market reviews (basic payment account availability, fee comparison tool used by Banka Slovenije), consumer Q&A on online payment abuse and bank refusals to refund — early indicator of recurring complaint patterns.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor 'aktualne vsebine', 'tržni pregledi' and consumer-Q&A sections; store links/metadata rather than full text given copyright
queries_used: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije pritožbe banke plačilne storitve

candidates.source_name: ZPS – Kam se obrniti, ko so kratene pravice potrošnikom (map of supervisory institutions)
candidates.why_relevant: Pointer page enumerating Slovenian supervisory/complaint bodies (TIRS, BSi, AZN, ATVP, IP-RS, ministries) — an actor map for the whole complaint-channel cell, useful for snowballing further sources.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off extraction of institution list to seed actor map; re-check annually
queries_used: Varuh človekovih pravic Slovenija banke pritožbe Tržni inšpektorat potrošniki finančne storitve

candidates.source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec RS (IP-RS) – GDPR/ZVOP-2 opinions (mnenja) including bank-specific ones
candidates.why_relevant: The Slovenian DPA publishes searchable non-binding opinions, many explicitly about banks (merger data transfers, employment data processing by banks, disclosure of client data between bank employees). These reveal where banks push data-processing boundaries and which systems are contested.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-crawl the mnenja index for 'banka', 'plačil', 'kartic', 'kredit'; store opinion IDs, dates, and controller references
queries_used: Informacijski pooblaščenec odločba banka varstvo osebnih podatkov

candidates.why_relevant: Explains inspection and complaint-decision powers under ZVOP-2/GDPR; the entry point for understanding what is and is not published about enforcement against banks and payment providers.

candidates.why_relevant: Inspection decisions (inšpekcijske odločbe) are reportedly NOT routinely published due to sensitivity, but are among the most-requested FOI items. This catalogue is the documented route to request specific decisions naming banks/PSPs.

candidates.legal_status: FOI (ZDIJZ) request required for decision texts
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual ZDIJZ request workflow for named-institution decisions; not automatable

negative_findings.description: Slovenia appears to have no dedicated statutory banking ombudsman (a 'bančni varuh'). Searches in Slovene surfaced only the ZBS-run IRPS ADR scheme and Banka Slovenije's supervisory complaint channel; the Human Rights Ombudsman is generalist and archive material discusses proposals for sectoral ombudsmen rather than an existing one.
negative_findings.result_summary: ADR for banking disputes is industry-run (ZBS) and its opinions are reportedly non-binding on banks, which limits the enforcement weight of that channel's outputs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Complaint-outcome data is therefore fragmented across ZBS, Banka Slovenije and courts; no single authoritative complaints register exists to track institution-level failure rates.

negative_findings.description: IP-RS inspection decisions (inšpekcijske odločbe) in the data-protection field are reportedly not routinely published on the DPA website due to sensitivity, despite being among the most-requested FOI items.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public register of named DPA enforcement decisions against Slovenian banks/PSPs was found; only opinions (mnenja) and an OPSI 'praksa' dataset were located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Institution-level DPA enforcement against banks will require FOI (ZDIJZ) requests or third-party aggregators, so automated monitoring alone will under-count enforcement events.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names 'AVP/court rulings'. In Slovenia AVP is the Agencija za varnost prometa (road-traffic safety agency), which has no banking or payments remit; no financial-sector body with that acronym was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a brief error; substituted the actual court-ruling sources (sodnapraksa.si, sodisce.si) and the actual sectoral supervisors (Banka Slovenije, AZN, ATVP).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated or misdirected source entry and corrects the actor map for downstream runs.

negative_findings.description: No centralised Slovenian outage/incident register for payment systems was found. Outage evidence is scattered across per-bank 'obvestila za stranke' pages and news reports; Bankart does not appear to publish a public status page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Outage tracking must be assembled from many per-institution pages plus media monitoring.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Correlating multi-bank outages to shared processors (Bankart) will depend on inference from timestamps rather than an authoritative feed.

negative_findings.description: No English-language equivalent was found for most Slovene complaint/fraud sources; ZBS's ADR page has an /en/ path but consumer-protection, police and DPA material is Slovene-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection would miss essentially the entire cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovene-language crawling and keyword lists are mandatory for this cell, not optional.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check EDPB national-decision pages and the GDPR Enforcement Tracker for Slovenian bank entries; prepare a standing ZDIJZ FOI template for IP-RS inspection decisions.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the Banka Slovenije register of supervised entities (https://www.bsi.si/sl/nadzor-bancnega-sistema/register-subjektov-nadzora) and derive one notice-page URL per institution.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over app-store review feeds and Slo-Tech/Reddit threads for outage and fraud complaint chatter; app-store reviews are the most structured of these.

coverage_gaps.description: sodnapraksa.si was confirmed to contain banking/payment consumer rulings, but no systematic query set or result-volume estimate was built for terms such as 'neodobrena plačilna transakcija', 'zloraba plačilne kartice', 'ZPlaSSIED'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and test a Slovene query set against the sodnapraksa.si search parameters and record hit counts per term to size the collection job.

brief: Slovenia's consumer-complaint and dispute signal for banking/payments is split across four layers: a supervisory complaint channel at Banka Slovenije, an industry-run out-of-court ADR scheme operated by Združenje bank Slovenije (opinions non-binding on banks), the ordinary courts via the sodnapraksa.si case-law database, and the consumer association ZPS. There is no statutory banking ombudsman and no central complaints register, so institution-level failure rates must be reconstructed from ZBS and Banka Slovenije annual reports plus court rulings. The sharpest operational signal comes from SI-CERT/Varni na internetu and Policija advisories on bank-impersonation phishing (which name banks and tie fraud waves to events such as the NKBM/SKB–OTP merger) and from per-bank 'obvestila za stranke' outage notices, which media coverage shows understate migration failures such as the BKS platform move. Data-protection enforcement is the weakest link: IP-RS publishes bank-related opinions and an OPSI open dataset, but inspection decisions are not routinely published and will need FOI requests or third-party aggregators. All of this is Slovene-language only, so local-language crawling is mandatory.
